contract.label: Radial gauge
contract.summary: The portal's gauge — one figure against its ceiling, drawn as an arc on a 100-unit ring with a 10-unit stroke and a 15% track, both in currentColor, at card and tile sizes.
contract.purpose: The portal's gauge — one figure against its ceiling, drawn as an arc on a 100-unit ring with a 10-unit stroke and a 15% track in the same colour, so the ring reads as one hue and follows the element's text colour.
useWhen: One percentage that has a ceiling and a target — demand reduction against a commitment, readings received against expected.
A list of such figures, one glanceable ring per row, at `size="tile"`.
dontUseWhen: A progress of a job in time — that is `progress` or `circular-progress`.
Several values to compare — that is a chart.

parts.name: RadialGauge
parts.description: The ring, its track, and the figure in the centre — a caption under it at card size, or any children in its place. Tone it with a text colour: a status -emphasis token when the figure is judged against a target, nothing for a neutral reading.

props.name: size
props.description: card (11rem) is the gauge as a card's own content, with the figure in display type and a caption; tile (4rem) is the glanceable one in a list row or a metric tile, with the figure alone.

requires: A tone only when the figure is judged against a target: `text-success-emphasis` when met, `text-warning-emphasis` when short, and a `badge` beside it that says the same in words. A neutral reading sets no colour.
An `aria-label` that says what the figure is and how it stands.
forbids: A hex or a hand-drawn SVG ring — the gauge is this component in both themes.
A status colour chosen for looks; `destructive` only when the figure is an error.
rules: `size="card"` is the gauge as a card's own content, with the figure in display type and a caption under it; `size="tile"` is the glanceable one in a list row or a metric tile, with the figure alone.
The tone is the element's text colour (`currentColor`), never a prop: `className="text-warning-emphasis"`.

behavior.loading: A `skeleton` circle of the gauge's size in its place.

requirements: The root is `role="img"` with an `aria-label` naming the figure and its standing; the SVG is hidden from assistive tech.

examples: `<RadialGauge value={86} label="of target" className="text-warning-emphasis" aria-label="Demand reduction: 86% of target, below target" />`
`<RadialGauge size="tile" value={98} className="text-success-emphasis" aria-label="98% of readings received" />`
antiPatterns: A `circular-progress` with its stroke and track hand-tuned to look like the portal's gauge.
A ring in `destructive` because the figure is low — short of target is `warning`.
